title: NS Clipper v1.1.5 — Production Update
changelog:
• Automatic AI Title generation for viral clips across Find Viral Clips, Editor, and Export
• Strict subtitle/caption isolation: dialogue subtitles remain 100% transcript-driven
• Instant person-to-person character hard-cut switching for Simple Face Tracking
• Center split feathering/blending with smooth cosine S-curve transition
• Windows-safe human-readable default export filenames with spaces
• Automated full-installer OTA upgrade pipeline and stability enhancements
